zoe: Quick GA sync: we need a minimal acceptance checklist covering data residency, SLA tiers, docs, and pricing. Short owners?
liam: I'll do SLOs. Tentative: Gold p99<200ms 99.95%; Silver p99<400ms 99.9%; Bronze best-effort.
anjali: I'll draft docs, runbook, and a residency FAQ (hosted/dedicated/private) + migration notes.
devin: Infra gating: per-tenant region pin + KMS audit export + smoke for KV cache pinning. ETA 48h for tests.
sam: Pricing: propose +20% Gold, +8% Silver. Legal wants credits-only remedies. Need billing examples for retries/overage.
zoe: Actions: liam SLO PR by EOD tomorrow; anjali docs in 48h; devin gating tests in 48h; sam pricing + one-pager in 72h. Flag blockers here.
liam: Also adding fallback policy: auto-fallback to quantized variant on burst latency.
anjali: Note: private deployments marked ‘SLA contingent on network test’ in runbook.
devin: Ops ok. smoke job queued.
sam: Sales one-pager coming.
zoe: Treat these as minimal GA criteria unless objections. Keep updates here.
